# InlineMessage

InlineMessage: a compact icon trigger that opens a Popup carrying the full message. Built on Popup so placement, dismissal and focus return are shared with every other popup in the system.

Also asked as: field error, helper error, inline error, form validation.

**Import:** `import { InlineMessage } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/messaging/InlineMessage/InlineMessage.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/messaging/InlineMessage/InlineMessage.stories.jsx` — Overview, Appearances, Info, Warning, Danger, Success, WithSecondaryText, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/messaging/InlineMessage/InlineMessage.mdx`

**Motion:** enter `spatial.fast` + `appearance.fast` · exit `spatial.fast` + `appearance.fast`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Usage

Use `InlineMessage` for a note that explains or qualifies something right
beside it, such as why a field is required or what a score means, without
taking up space until someone asks. It is built on `Popup`, so placement,
dismissal and focus return are shared with every other popup in the system.

For a message that belongs to a whole page or section and should always be
visible, use `Banner` or `SectionMessage` instead. `InlineMessage` is for
detail that most people will never need to open.

### Appearance guidance

| Appearance | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Info | The default, for a neutral explanation. |
| Warning | The note is cautionary: say what happens if they proceed. |
| Danger | The note explains something that failed or is blocked. |
| Success | The note confirms an outcome. |

## Motion

InlineMessage reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enter | Add or remove an item | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Makes room, then fades in. |
| exit | Add or remove an item | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Fades, then the room closes. |

## Best practices

### Match the tint to the meaning. {#match-the-tint-to-the-meaning}

Info for a neutral note; danger only when something failed. The icon is a
second cue, not a style choice.

Do: Info for a neutral note.
Don't: Danger for a neutral note.

### Keep it to one short line. {#keep-it-to-one-short-line}

It sits beside a field; long copy pushes the form around.

Do: One short sentence.
Don't: A paragraph beside a field.

### Show one message per field. {#show-one-message-per-field}

Two messages on one field leave no clear next step.

Do: A single message.
Don't: An info note and a warning together.

### Write the label as the question the popup answers. {#write-the-label-as-the-question-the-popup-answers}

The trigger is an icon button with no text of its own, so `label` carries its
accessible name and its tooltip. Write "Why this field is required", not
"info" or "more".

## Accessibility

- **The trigger is a real button.** It is reached with Tab and opens with
  Enter or Space, same as any `IconButton`.
- **`label` is required.** It is the trigger's only accessible name; a vague
  label like "info" tells a screen reader nothing about what the popup holds.
- **Focus and dismissal follow `Popup`.** Opening moves focus into the popup;
  Escape or a click outside closes it and returns focus to the trigger.

## Related

- For the popup mechanics this component is built on, see `Popup`.
- For a message that stays visible without being opened, use `SectionMessage` or `Banner`.

Same group: `Banner` · `EmptyState` · `Flag` · `Modal` · `NotificationItem` · `SectionMessage` · `Spotlight`

## Parts

1. **Trigger.** A subtle, compact icon button in the appearance color, named by `label`.
2. **Popup.** Opens on press with a title, optional secondary line and body.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The icon in its appearance color; the popup closed. |
| Hovered | The subtle neutral fill behind the icon button. |
| Pressed | A stronger neutral fill. |
| Focused | The 2px ring, 2px off the trigger, for keyboard focus only. |
| Disabled | Not supported. |
| Open | The Popup is shown with its own fill, shadow and radius. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Trigger icon | `--ds-icon-information`, `--ds-icon-warning`, `--ds-icon-danger`, `--ds-icon-success`, set on the icon in the jsx rather than the scss |
| Title | `--heading-small` |
| Secondary text | `--body-default`, `--ds-text-subtle` |
| Spacing | `--stack-sm` |

The popup surface is Popup's; see `Popup`.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Warning: say what happens if they proceed and offer an alternative. | Alarm without a next step. |
| Error: explain the problem and give a next step. | Use technical detail or blame the person. |
| Confirmation: confirm the outcome and get out of the way. | Add detail the person did not ask for. |
| Keep the title concise, in sentence case. | Let the message run past five lines. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `appearance` | enum | `'info'` | The trigger's icon and tint. |
| `label` | string (required) | — | The trigger icon's accessible name and tooltip. Required: it is the only visible part before the popup opens. |
| `title` | node | — | Bolded first line of the popup. |
| `secondaryText` | node | — | A second line, when the title alone does not say enough. |
| `placement` | enum | `'bottom-start'` | Where the popup opens relative to the trigger. |
| `children` | node | — | The popup's body content. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `id` | string | — | — |
